caption_L1: Here a area chart is named Number of Honda cars sold in Switzerland from 2009 to 2019. A linear scale from 2010 to 2018 can be seen along the x-axis, marked Year. Along the y-axis, Units sold is defined.
caption_L2L3: Sales of Honda cars have been on a general downward trend in Switzerland since 2009. The worst year for Honda car sales was 2015, with only around 3,500 sold. Sales bounce back in 2013 and 2016.  Sales of Honda cars wereroughly 50% less in 2019 than they were a decade before in 2009.
